abn-detail.eventDescription: One full Australian Business Register record: ABN, entity name, ABN status and date, entity type, GST registration, main business location, ACN, and charity and deductible gift recipient flags.

asic-registration.eventDescription: The ACN, ARBN, ARSN or ARFN for one ABN plus the link to its ASIC register record. Charged only when the entity has one.

dgr-status.eventDescription: The DGR endorsement for one ABN: the date it was endorsed from and the item of the table in section 30-15 it is covered by. Charged only for entities that are endorsed.

dgr-funds.eventDescription: The separate funds, authorities and institutions one entity operates that can receive deductible gifts, each with its DGR item and date range. Charged only when the entity operates at least one.

acnc-registration.eventDescription: The Australian Charities and Not-for-profits Commission registration for one ABN: status, date registered from and the link to its ACNC record. Charged only for registered charities.

charity-tax-concessions.eventDescription: The charity type, such as Public Benevolent Institution, and every endorsed tax concession with its start date. Charged only when the entity holds at least one concession.

acnc-charity-profile.eventDescription: A separate lookup in the ACNC charity register for one ABN: street address, website, charity size, registration date, responsible persons, financial year end, operating states and charitable purposes. Charged only when the ABN is found there.

abn-history.eventDescription: A separate request for the historical details of one ABN: the full history of entity name, ABN status, GST registration and main business location, each with a from and to date.

name-history.eventDescription: The historical business and trading names for one ABN with their from and to dates, including names that are no longer current. Read from the same request as ABN history and never re-billed for it.

abn-statistics.eventDescription: One group from the statistical query of the register, with its count of Australian Business Numbers.

statistics-query.eventDescription: One statistical query executed against ABN Lookup, covering the count option, year, GST filter, states and grouping.
